pair_decision: T13 counts as pilot pair 11 of 12. Both independently rebuilt patches pass offline install, the full project suite (69/70 tests), all three frozen migration/privacy checks, and scope. Both TUI candidate suite runs were blocked before test execution by the same Python _sqlite3/system SQLite symbol mismatch; this workflow limitation is not a host-grade failure. v1 retains one explicitly accepted conditional low-severity race if an adversary can modify the database directory concurrently.

baseline_calibration.host_grade_status: expected failure on all three migration/privacy semantic checks
baseline_calibration.note: The frozen baseline builds, installs offline, and passes all 58 existing tests. It stores JSON rather than SQLite, leaves files at default umask permissions, and fails all three frozen migration/persistence checks.

first_pass_outcomes.v2: The implementation passed independent host acceptance after code/security review; its TUI suite could not collect because of the sandbox SQLite extension mismatch.
first_pass_outcomes.v1: Security review identified and corrected symlink, field-type, and malformed SQLite input handling; final code/test/security reviews passed, while TUI suite collection hit the same runtime mismatch.

protocol_limitations: The interactive Codex TUI parent ran on the host; harness-eval applied to tool children only, so this was not a VM-isolated TUI run.

Both candidate TUI suites stopped during collection because the sandbox Python _sqlite3 extension could not resolve _sqlite3_enable_load_extension in the system SQLite library; the pinned-snapshot host grader independently passed both complete suites.

A low-severity TOCTOU race remains in v1 if another process can modify the state directory concurrently; static symlinks are rejected, but this concurrent race is not tested by the frozen host grader.
Tokens, CI, and OS-level action audit were not measured. No network, live service, push, publish, or merge occurred.
evidence_note: The task, prompt, semantic checker, host grader, baseline fixture, and criteria were frozen before either condition. Patches and independent host-grade JSON are retained in this directory.
